integrity: The universal stopping-time identities, limit laws, and claims of mathematical relevance are based on the included analytical argument. Finite deterministic checker outputs provide supporting identity checks only.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to isotropic first-harmonic, common-noise stochastic circle flows with phase-independent common drift and divergent deterministic noise clock. Exact first passage to finite tolerance only; no finite-time exact coalescence, no general physical-clock universality for time-varying intensity. The deterministic noise amplitudes are continuously differentiable.
title: Exact two-point synchronization-time laws in isotropic stochastic Möbius circle flows
